prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original flat square textile artwork master for a sample modern Filipiniana collection.
Primary request: Create one original painterly botanical artwork, designed as a printed fabric motif. Ivory canvas, airy plum and periwinkle flowers, very restrained muted green leaves. Loose lilac blossoms and slender stems spaced with generous light canvas.
Style: visible natural brush edges, layered gouache-like color, fine painterly stems and petals, contemporary wearable-gallery mood. Original invented floral forms, not a recreation of any known artist or painting.
Composition: square 1:1, flat edge-to-edge artwork without frame, fabric folds, photographed props, or borders. Scatter medium-scale botanical motifs across the square with balance and generous negative space. Motifs can continue beyond the edges; keep a consistent light ground. The artwork should work as an all-over garment print at a modest scale.
Constraints: no words, signature, labels, watermark, logos, people, clothing, collage, or mockup. No faux painting attribution. One square artwork only.
alt_text: AI-generated amihan garden botanical artwork concept.
acceptance_notes: Inspected: approved palette, painterly botanical forms, flat square, no text, logos, frame, or attribution.

prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: amihan-bolero, primary product photograph for an AI sample catalog.
Input image 1: exact original textile artwork reference, not the scene or painting prop.
Photorealistic premium Shopify catalog photograph, warm ivory seamless gallery studio, soft broad daylight from the left, gentle real floor shadow, natural color, matte finely woven fabric, crisp seams and realistic clothing construction. Photograph, not illustration, no embroidery: the reference artwork is PRINTED on fabric. All-over modest-scale repeated print, preserving the exact flowers, leaves, brush strokes, colors and ivory ground of the artwork reference. No words, logo, tags, watermark, collage or contact sheet. One photograph, 4:5 portrait composition, enough breathing room for the entire garment and both sleeve edges.
Subject: An anonymous adult Filipina fashion model, dark hair in a simple low bun, natural skin texture and light makeup, calm confident expression. No resemblance to a public figure. Relaxed posture, hands naturally down and away from product, no hand-in-pocket pose.
Product construction and framing: Waist-length open-front bolero with a softly curved open centre, structured upright Filipiniana butterfly sleeves, fully lined matte ivory inner face, single invisible concealed centre-front hook, no pockets. Clearly separate open bolero edges over a plain ivory camisole; no lapels, buttons, lace, ties or embroidery. Style with a plain ivory fitted-waist midi skirt, all supporting pieces excluded. Front-facing view, model framed head to mid thigh, full sleeves and cropped hem visible.
Keep printed botanical motifs roughly 10–18cm across flowers in garment scale, airy ivory space, realistic continuity over fabric folds. Make the silhouette easy to evaluate. The catalog item is the specified garment only.
alt_text: Sample amihan bolero, front view on an anonymous model in the botanical print.
acceptance_notes: Inspected: artwork palette/motifs preserved, correct garment silhouette, full sleeves/hem shown as applicable, natural anatomy, no text/logos.

prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: amihan-terno-set, primary AI sample product photograph.
Create a new premium catalog photograph of the MATCHING TWO-PIECE SET. Input 1 is the exact bolero and the model identity/studio lighting reference. Input 2 is the exact A-line midi skirt. Input 3 is the exact artwork print. Dress the model from image 1 in the identical bolero from image 1 AND the identical skirt from image 2. Preserve their construction, printed flower motifs, scale, colors, ivory ground, seam and hem shapes. Bolero is waist-length, open front over ivory camisole, upright structured Filipiniana butterfly sleeves and invisible centre-front hook. Skirt has fitted narrow waistband, gentle A-line calf-length flare, no pockets/slit/gathers; ivory lining, concealed side zip. Both pieces must be separately identifiable; do not make a one-piece dress. Plain ivory camisole and ivory sandals only, excluded styling pieces; no belt. Front-facing full-body portrait, entire sleeves and skirt hem visible, 4:5 composition with breathing room. Warm ivory seamless studio, soft natural light, realistic matte woven fabric and skin texture, relaxed hands down, photorealistic. No words, labels, logos, watermark, collage or contact sheet. One photograph.
alt_text: Sample amihan terno set, front view on an anonymous model.
acceptance_notes: Inspected: matching separate bolero and skirt design/print, distinct two-piece construction, full sleeves and midi hem, natural anatomy.
